about_the_game:
RAMEN RUSH is a ramen shop simulation with a fun arcade twist. In the “15-Day Mode”, you manage your own shop and build strategies each day to reach a specific income goal.

Each day, you must build your menu with a new product: 1 ramen, 1 drink, and optionally 1 side dish. But be careful! Compatibility between items is critical for customer satisfaction and sales success. As time goes on, product variety increases, making it harder to choose the right combinations. Careful planning and quick decisions are essential for success!


Every 5 days, you unlock a new skill for your character. These abilities are chosen based on your playstyle and give unique advantages. Over time, your choices will shape you into a true ramen master.


Prepare the ingredients, boil the ramen, and serve customers on time! There’s no inventory limit, but you are racing against the clock – if you’re too slow, customers will lose patience and leave!

In this fast-paced mode, your reflexes will be tested. The quick gameplay loop and replayability will help you improve day by day.


RAMEN RUSH features a rich soundtrack with both energetic tracks to keep you motivated and calm melodies for more peaceful moments. You'll stay immersed while enjoying both the action and the atmosphere.
